QuestInfo.name: Anne's Misunderstanding
QuestInfo.0: Big Headward, in #bHenesys Ruins#k, has something on his mind.
QuestInfo.1: Big Headward thinks Anne misunderstood him, and wants to gift her a Superior Bow to resolve the situation. Defeat #rAdvanced Knight Ds#k to get the #bSuperior Bow#k, and give it to Anne.
QuestInfo.2: You gave a Knight's Superior Bow to Anne and helped reconcile her and Big Headward.

0.0: Hello! You defeating Cygnus is the talk of the town! I knew your hair was something special, but I never would have guessed it would be THIS special. Thanks to you, I can return to the life of a stylist.

yes.0: Something Anne likes... All I can think of is a bow. Anne isn't interested in hairstyles.
yes.1: How about one of those #bSuperior Bows#k the #rAdvanced Knights#k carry? That might work.

no.0: Well, if you're busy, you're busy. By the way, would you like to have your hair done?

0.1: But I see it in your eyes, you know I am full of worry. Why, you ask? *sigh* Anne has been shooting me dirty looks recently for some reason. There must be some sort of misunderstanding.
0.2: I'm hoping giving her a gift might help smooth things over. Could you help me find one?

1.0: It's good to see you again. The mood around town has improved so much. It feels like we can take on anything now, and it's all thanks to you.

yes.0: That wasn't glaring, I just wanted to keep an eye on him. Since he doesn't quite have the skills to back up his gusto, he might get himself hurt. And I mean, he's not exactly a small target, if you catch my drift.
yes.1: Anyway, thanks for the bow. It will be a great help in fighting those mutant monsters.

npc.0: Please get a #bSuperior Bow#k carried by #rAdvanced Knights#k, and give it to Anne. That might resolve the misunderstanding.

item.0: What brings you here? Do you have something for me?

1.1: Hmm? Big Headward wants to give me a Superior Bow because I glared at him?
